## Code Review Findings Summary

- **Architecture & Conventions**: Conforms to `AGENTS.md` and repository standards (Node.js >= 22 LTS, strict TypeScript mode, `NodeNext` module resolution, Vitest).
- **Code Cleanliness & Smell Baseline**: Replaced naive ellipsis string truncation with ANSI-aware line wrapping (`wrapText` and `stripAnsi`). Zero Fowler code smells detected.

### Spec Axis (PR #60)
- **Target Title & ID Prominence**: Accurately fetches and prominently displays target PR/issue ID and title on dedicated card lines.
- **DoD Isolation in Parser**: Correctly scopes metadata parsing in `parseRunLog` strictly to the `## Metadata` section, preventing `YES` values from DoD table rows from clobbering the target ID.

- **Verification**: Complete unit test coverage added in `tests/terminal-card.test.ts` (157 unit tests passing across 21 test files).

### Security Pass
